name: orders_sdk
_comment_requires: orders_sdk >= 1.20.0 carries the manager window for the launcher canvas (approved design strip frames 53f/53l): the integrations below inject it under launch_sdk's '// @launcher-windows' / '// @launcher-windows-imports' markers and build it with LaunchWindowSource.widget, both of which exist from launch_sdk >= 1.4.3; on an older launch_sdk the composer reports the marker missing and skips the wiring (window absent, nothing else changes), and in hosts without launch_sdk the target file does not exist and the entry is skipped the same way. orders_sdk >= 1.19.0 lays the walk-in order flow on planes (approved design strip section 37, frames 37a-37e: WalkInPlaneFlow + WalkInBoardRail in lib/, the installed create_order templates as host shells) on the same base_sdk >= 1.43.0 plane model (PlaneHost/PlanePage.allowNeighbors/FloatingBackPill) 1.11.0 already requires - no new base_sdk requirement. orders_sdk >= 1.18.0 hosts order history's 38a plane flow as package code (OrderHistoryPlaneFlow; the installed page is the host shell) with no new base_sdk requirement. orders_sdk >= 1.14.0 charges a saved card by its Saved Card docname (`SavedCardModel.id`), not by a gateway reuse credential, so it requires base_sdk >= 1.50.0 (SavedCardModel without `token`, and the `name` -> `id` fallback that fills the handle) and a backend carrying pay's saved-card confinement (pay#46: `process_token_payment` keyed on `saved_card`). Against an older backend the charge is refused WITHOUT being made, never mis-charged. This also covers the client half that shipped unversioned in commerce#92. orders_sdk >= 1.13.0 carries the collected-in-person conversion (approved strip section 43): the ONE atomic seller endpoint lives in merchants (`convert_delivery_to_collected`), so a manager compose wanting the convert lane needs merchants_sdk >= 1.20.0 on the backend side; without it the lane's single call fails through ApiResult.failure rather than half-converting anything. orders_sdk >= 1.12.0 requires base_sdk >= 1.46.0 (the STANDARD LIST LANGUAGE - ListFilterTabBar/ListCountPill/ListScreenHeader/ListViewMore and ListDetailFlow/ListPlaneColumns from approved design strip section 38, which order history is drawn in). orders_sdk >= 1.11.0 requires base_sdk >= 1.43.0 (PlaneHost/Planes/PlaneSpan and FloatingBackPill from the approved plane model — the manager orders workspace hosts its board + order-detail flow in planes per approved frame 33d). orders_sdk >= 1.9.0 carries the int->String docname id migration for the manager/POS slice (Frappe hash docnames; fleet-wide sweep). orders_sdk >= 1.6.0 requires base_sdk >= 1.11.0 (AdaptiveShell/SplitPane/window-size classes from core PR #35 — the wide-screen order board and split create-order layouts import them; >= 1.4.0 required base_sdk >= 1.6.0: CustomerCartStore/kCartSyncOpType and SyncEngine.enqueueOrReplace from the offline-first Phase 3 customer cart, core PR #16; 1.3.0 needed only base_sdk >= 1.5.0's SyncEngine/SyncHandler APIs from Phase 0, core PR #15); the composer manifest schema has no machine-readable minimum-version field, so this is the declaration. orders_sdk >= 1.16.1 requires base_sdk >= 1.56.0: MockOrdersRepository's demo shop logo is one of base_sdk's DemoImages (an inline data: URI), which only base_sdk >= 1.56.0 renders - older base_sdk hands it to CachedNetworkImage and draws its broken-image state.
_comment_integrations: Approved design strip frames 53f and 53l (Ray 2026-09-01): the manager window on the launcher canvas - the orders waiting to be accepted, and the takings figure deliberately absent (53f chip 1289, the frame's extension of Ray's 53e money ruling). When the host also composes launch_sdk >= 1.4.3 (its installed home page ships the '// @launcher-windows' marker at lib/presentation/pages/launch/home.dart, and '// @launcher-windows-imports' at column 0 among its imports), inject a LaunchWindowSource.widget for manager mode whose content is this SDK's ManagerLaunchWindow. Two entries because the window is this SDK's widget and the launcher never imports orders_sdk on its own: the imports marker takes the import, the windows marker takes the source. Same substring-replace rules as productivity_sdk's launcher glance: the windows placeholder carries its 16-space indent so it cannot match the column-0 imports marker, of which the bare marker text is a prefix. LaunchWindowSource, LaunchMode, AppHelpers and RemixIcons are already imported by the launch home template. The package the window opens is the MANAGER_ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME define the launcher derived the mode from (LaunchWindowSource.widget's default), so nothing is named here. The launcher owns the chrome and the dataless back-seat row (Ray: 'data dont show on launcher when another mode is active'); ManagerLaunchWindow draws only the content - 'Orders to accept', the 'Waiting on you' count and one Open orders action, no amount. It reads the SellerOrdersRepositoryFacade when the manager DI hook registered one, the demo seller-orders repository in an IS_DEMO build otherwise, and draws the headline and the action without a count when neither answers. Top-level rather than under app_type.manager because the launcher compose declares no app role; the composer strips lib/src/manager/ only for a host whose role this SDK declares and which is not manager, so a manager or role-less host always has the file. This SDK still never imports launch_sdk (ADR-005).

integrations.replacement:
LaunchWindowSource.widget(
                  mode: LaunchMode.manager,
                  title: AppHelpers.getTranslation('manager'),
                  icon: RemixIcons.store_2_line,
                  builder: (context, openApp) =>
                      ManagerLaunchWindow(onOpen: openApp),
                ),

_comment_tr_keys: Frames 53f/53l's copy on the launcher window - the headline, the count's label and the action - plus the back-seat row's title for manager mode (53e chip 1288). Top-level (not the manager flavor block) because the window is injected into a launcher host that declares no app role, and the keys must be seeded there too. ManagerLaunchWindow references these by wire key string (ManagerLaunchWindowKeys) because lib/ analyzes and tests against raw base_sdk; the installer keeps the first declaration on a collision, so a host that already carries 'manager' is unaffected.

routes._comment: Route names carry a Manager prefix (revenue_sdk's ManagerIncomeRoute convention) but keep paas_manager's exact legacy paths and CupertinoRoute/MaterialRoute types, so host navigation call-sites swap class names only. merchants_sdk's main_page.dart FAB pushes ManagerCreateOrderRoute - that name is this manifest's contract. The installed pages carry @RoutePage(name: 'Manager...Route'), so auto_route generates the classes in the host's own app_router.gr.dart.

manager._comment_di_hooks: The manager role DI + ADR-005 POS facade adapters, moved out of paas_manager's tracked main.dart into the #160 di_hooks mechanism (manager migration M5, scratchpad/di-hooks-declarations.md). The facade registrations are isRegistered-guarded so a host whose tracked main.dart still registers them by hand (its own migration window) double-boots safely; after the host untracks lib/, the hook is the only registration. ManagerOrdersDependencies.register is internally guarded already.

customer._comment_tr_keys: Parcel COD (1.7.0): the sender-side 'driver collects cash from the recipient' toggle in the parcel creation flow. 18+ checkout (1.8.0): the age-verification DOB sheet and the two friendly create_order failure messages (AGE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED / UNDERAGE_PURCHASE_BLOCKED). lib/src/common/ code references these by wire key string via AppHelpers.getTranslation (products_sdk's seller_form_helpers precedent) because lib/ analyzes against raw base_sdk where composer-injected constants don't exist; getTranslation prettifies the snake_case keys into readable English until the translation store carries them. Declared under a customer block (booking_sdk precedent for the app_type name) since the parcel flow ships in customer composes; no installs/routes - tr_keys only, like delivery_sdk's driver block.

routes._comment: Pre-fork customer order/parcel route table recovered (fix-wave 2026-09-02, route map rows 11/13/23/35/36/38/39). Paths are paas_customer's exact strings; shells live in orders_customer_route_pages.dart and are named as base_sdk's AppRoutes seam expects. Under app_type.customer only: the manager flavour's /order is ManagerOrderRoute and never composes alongside.

customer._comment_routes: Customer routes + AppRoutes seams (fix-wave 2026-09-02). `params` strings must match base_sdk's AppRoutes signatures verbatim; dynamic args are coerced before reaching the typed shells.

_comment_app_type: manager: paas_manager's orders + POS vertical (order queues, order details, POS create-order flow with shipping/section/table/customer pickers, order history). Application layer, models, facades and the seller orders / POS products repositories live in lib/src/manager/ - declaring this manager block also keeps that folder alive through sdk_composer.py's strip_unused_role_folders. The manager host must call ManagerOrdersDependencies.register (direct src/ import) and register the two ADR-005 seam adapters installed at lib/presentation/routes/orders_adapters.dart (owners: merchants_sdk for sections/tables, users_sdk for customers); unwired seams degrade to visible 501 failures, not crashes. OrdersHomePage installs to lib/presentation/pages/orders/orders_home_page.dart - the exact path merchants_sdk's main_page.dart shell imports; it is tab-hosted, so it declares no route. Cross-vertical widgets the POS pages reference via ${package} host paths (custom_app_bar, filter_screen, loading list/shimmers, modal helpers, categories_tab_bar, shop_bordered_avatar, buttons_bouncing_effect from merchants' install) stay host-owned until the dedup workstream settles them. Requires .rokct/config/app_type = manager. Version bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 so version-aware cache reconciliation re-extracts composed copies, then 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 (adopted custom_icon_button, text_loading and select_date_modal from base_sdk per the component triage - each is used by this SDK's templates only; installed to the host's lib/presentation/component/ SINGULAR paths deliberately, because those are the exact paths the existing manager templates import, so no template rewrites are needed).
_comment_tr_keys: Declared here rather than hand-written into base_sdk because only this SDK uses them (kitchen_sdk's mechanism/comment). Checked against base_sdk's hand-written keys (the original 39 were exactly the manager orders/POS keys absent there; 1.6.0 adds delivered/canceled for the wide-screen board's two history columns; 1.11.0 adds accepted/cooking/ready/on_a_way plus view_more/drop_here/pickup_skips_on_a_way/start_end for the approved seven-column board — checked against base's hand-written keys and kitchen_sdk's kitchen/kitchens, no collision; 1.13.0 adds the 33 collected-in-person keys for approved strip section 43 - the deliveryman row, the convert lane and its offline relabel, the two outcome lines, Ray's till line, the four confirm-guard ledger rows and the two converted-card notes - checked against base's hand-written keys, kitchen_sdk's two and this manifest's own, no collision) and against kitchen_sdk's two keys - no collision. Values are paas_manager's legacy wire keys verbatim, including the 'spproximate' typo the translation store already contains.
_comment_asset_keys: Injected into base's AppAssets between the @sdk-asset-keys markers; the files themselves arrive via the installs above. lottiePin is also declared by marketplace_sdk (customer compose) - flavor-gating keeps the two from ever meeting in one app; if they do someday, the installer keeps whichever it sees first, and both point at assets/lottie/pin.json anyway.
